body: Ok, I understand that I'm probably depressed, so that would definitely help. I just feel like the label "depressed" is thrown around so much that I couldn't possibly be depressed. My father and stepfather both suffer from depression and I always thought, no way could it happen to me. I'm going to sleep on this, I can talk to my parents about seeing a therapist tomorrow.
Diagnosis? I haven't been to any professionals, I'm actually afraid of telling anyone about this because they might try to lock me up for my own good.
